'''March 2001 Framingham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Video Connection, Framingham, MA on 3 March 2001. [[Steve Baroni]] won it. It is known from Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1828">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-travis-at-framingham-3-3-01d1828/ travis-at-framingham-3-3-01], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 4 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-travis-at-framingham-3-3-01d1828/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Video Connection, Framingham, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
